rows.name: New Blade: M.O.M.O. Joins the Fight

It seems Tora has something useful.
Once Hana has joined your party,
visit his house in Torigo.

You can now control Blades directly
and fight in action battles.
After completing a certain Merc Group
mission, visit Merc Group HQ.

Homura and Hikari now have new styles.
You can switch them in Options.
Scan a Homura or Hikari amiibo, or earn
them as a first Merc Group Action reward.

Compared to the original version,
events now have higher resolution
and frame rates. Some also include
scene-matched vibration effects.

Receive daily bonuses such as EXP
and items (up to three amiibo a day).
Scanning a Homura or Hikari amiibo
also unlocks their new styles.
